text:
maya (PM): quick sync on private preview pilots — we have 12 seats. need to finalize tracks, onboarding checklist, selection rubric, and emergency rollback terms by Friday. low friction please.

jon (GTM): suggestion: two tracks (integrate & validate). Integrate = 4 wks, validate = 2 wks. Integrate gets more support and deeper metrics.

sam (Eng): ops note: our safe concurrency is ~8 mid-weight pilots. if we do 12, need scheduling + wave plan or we'll staggersmash the infra.

priya (Eng): agree with waves. propose wave 1 = 5 partners, wave 2 = 5, reserve 2 for case studies. each wave starts 2 weeks apart.

lina (CS): onboarding checklist we use with customers today can map over. quick draft suggestions: 1) data inventory + PII flags 2) API access & scopes 3) baseline perf tests 4) alert routing 5) weekly checkpoints.

clare (Legal): flag: any partners that want sample data handled by Redwood private infra need a minimal DPA addendum. capture that in screening to avoid surprises.

maya (PM): good call. screening form should gate: expected queries/day, data sensitivity (none/low/medium/high), SLAs needed, public case-study ok?

jon (GTM): also add a short question: primary success metric (e.g., user retention uplift, latency p50 <200ms, cost per inference target). Prioritize partners with clear metrics.

sam (Eng): rollback triggers we should commit to: 1) sustained error rate >3% for 24h 2) latency >3x baseline p50 for 6h 3) confirmed data leak. those are auto-unprovision events.

priya (Eng): add: partner can request pause for false positives; ops review window 2h for human-in-the-loop. we'll notify partner pre-rollback unless security incident.

devops-bot: alert rule created: "pilot-latency-3x" -> notify #eng-oncall, #product, and partner-ops.

clare (Legal): include a short text snippet in invites about data handling and rollback rights. I can draft a one-paragraph clause.

lina (CS): incentives: for integrate track offer 2000 credits + 8 hours of solutions time. for validate track offer 800 credits + templated prompts. Also offer a co-marketing call for the 2 case-study slots.

maya (PM): selection rubric items: business impact (30%), technical fit (25%), measurability (20%), compliance burden (15%), PR value (10%). ana/ops to score.

jon (GTM): recruiting channels: account execs, existing dedicated customers, and a small public form. we should also let solutions nominate 3 customers.

sam (Eng): capacity plan: wave 1 (weeks 1-4) onboard 5 integrate + 1 case study; wave 2 (weeks 3-6) onboard remaining. schedule deep tests in week 2 for each partner.

priya (Eng): deploy windows: prefer non-overlapping heavy runs between 10am-4pm PT. ops will mark blackout windows on calendar.

clare (Legal): once we have list, I'll do a quick legal risk triage (data transfer, export controls, specific vendor clauses). need 48h per partner.

maya (PM): action items: jon -> screening form + outreach email by Wed; lina -> incentive list + onboarding template by Wed; sam/priya -> wave schedule + rollback automation runbook by Thurs; clare -> DPA snippet + triage checklist by Thurs. I'll compile invites on Friday and send wave1 invites Monday.

lina (CS): will also prepare a partner FAQ on data handling. reduces back-and-forth.

sam (Eng): I'll link a lightweight runbook here with alert thresholds and playbook steps.

jon (GTM): noted. aiming to fill wave 1 by next Thu. will loop in AE owners.

maya (PM): thanks all. keep updates brief in this thread. closing: swift decisions and clear commit language = better exec outcomes. :white_check_mark:
